principle: Professional roles generate, independent roles review, and delivery status is derived from review gates. No deterministic code gates remain; reasoning is carried only in roles/review-templates/*.md.
note: This is a pure-LLM-reasoning-driven architecture. Roles no longer produce JSON Schema / YAML instances, and there is no design_graph / specification compilation output; each generation role writes its reasoning conclusions directly into the role Markdown sections it owns. This file defines the allowed boundaries of roles (responsibilities, inputs, decision authority, prohibitions, allowed handoff/review targets); actual stage routing and carrier documents follow workflow.json.

globalHardGates.reasoningStageCompletion: A reasoning stage can only be recorded as completed/blocked through a complete stage receipt; it must not write pass directly or reconstruct the trace in bulk after the fact
globalHardGates.minimumCompleteness: Every owned output must pass the minimumCompletenessGate in its template; placeholders, empty sample tables, and summaries substituting for item-by-item facts are all block
globalHardGates.independentReviewEvidence: Every review stage must record a fresh_context/isolated_subagent invocationId, the exact reviewedRevision, evidenceRebuilt=yes, and recommendation; if missing, the whole thing is review_blocked
globalHardGates.previewDenominator: When the Coverage Manifest is missing, the denominator has no basis and is 0, the generation side and QA rebuilt denominators are inconsistent, or the five maps are incomplete, designStatus=invalid
globalHardGates.hostAcceptance: A worker must not approve its own delivery; only after the main thread re-reads trace/critique/preview QA and derives ready_for_design_delivery is external app generation allowed

roles.mission: Turn the request and evidence into product outcomes, boundaries, success criteria, and risk requirements.
selfCheck: outcomes are measurable
unknowns remain explicit
differentiation target anchors §3A competitive benchmark

roles.mission: Provide traceable user, market, domain, platform, and safety evidence, a competitive benchmark, and a structured domain model.
ownedOutputs: roles/review-templates/uxr-research-report.md (five categories of evidence, §3A competitive benchmark, domain model sections)
selfCheck: assumptions are not presented as facts
competitive patterns are absorbed only at the requirement/opportunity layer and never copied as UI

roles.mission: Turn product intent and evidence into tasks, decisions, dependencies, consequences, and time scales.
selfCheck: tasks describe user decisions rather than screens
coverage is checked against §3A competitor function analysis

roles.mission: Turn tasks into spatial value, concepts, containers, window accessories, sizing, states, and flows.
ownedOutputs: roles/review-templates/interaction-spatial-spec.md (Section 2 Design Principles, 4 Spatial Value, 5 Hypotheses, 6 Concept Selection, 7 Experience and Container Architecture, 8 Window Attachment, 9 Window Sizing, 10 State Graph / Transition Graph, 11 User Flow)
selfCheck: Stage is used only with spatial value
every flow has a stable return
spatial opportunities are contrasted with competitors' spatial usage

roles.mission: Turn the selected concept into a project-specific visual direction and an approved visual reference.
ownedOutputs: roles/review-templates/visual-system-spec.md (Section 2 Spatial Visual Direction Candidates, Section 3 Design Tokens in collaboration with spatial_design_system_designer)
selfCheck: directions differ beyond color
meaning is not color-only
competitor visuals are used as a differentiation foil only, never reused

roles.mission: Synthesize composition, layout, components, visual grammar, interaction, motion, and data trust from approved design facts, and perform bounded graph patches.
ownedOutputs: roles/review-templates/interaction-spatial-spec.md (Section 9 Window Sizing, 12 Eye-Hand Interaction, 13 Motion, 14 Layout Skeleton and Placement Geometry)
roles/review-templates/visual-system-spec.md (Section 3 Design Tokens, 5 Structured Component Anatomy, 6 Materials and Depth Semantics, 7 Data Display and Semantic Contract)
requiredInputs: PICO-methodology window sizing (default/min/max, content area, reflow)
outputRequirements: the incompressible complete structure block of each core component
selfCheck: components trace to tasks and data
each core component preserves the full anatomy/sizing/metrics/renderSpec/dataBindings/variants/states structure
component sizing/metrics fit the owning WindowContainer default/min/max content area
common tables never replace component-specific facts
Reduce Motion is specified
patches are local and never rewrite the whole design

roles.mission: Generate a single-file Web validation prototype that only consumes design facts from the role documents.
requiredInputs: Preview input readiness table all pass
PICO-methodology window sizing (default/min/max, content area, reflow)
evidenceRequired: responsive window-tier and Reduce Motion facts
selfCheck: no domain template is used
no device or parity claim is made
coverage denominator comes from individual design facts rather than component names
every declared fallback and component-specific state is demonstrable

roles.mission: Independently review intent, quality contract, research evidence, the competitive benchmark, and the domain model.
ownedOutputs: roles/review-templates/design-critique-report.md (problem and evidence gate findings + patch goals)
selfCheck: review does not rewrite artifacts
verifies ≥3 competitors, four-dimension coverage, and bounded adoption
independenceRequirements: must run in fresh_context or isolated_subagent
must not reuse generator conclusions as evidence
must record invocationId and reviewed artifact revision
must return block when independent invocation is unavailable

roles.mission: Independently review task decisions, spatial value, alternatives, and concept selection.
selfCheck: reviewer role differs from artifact owner
independenceRequirements: must run in fresh_context or isolated_subagent
must not reuse generator conclusions as evidence
must record invocationId and reviewed artifact revision
must return block when independent invocation is unavailable

roles.mission: Independently review coherence across visual direction, architecture, states, layout, components, interaction, and data.
selfCheck: review does not become a redesign
any missing core-component structure produces block before coverage or scoring
independenceRequirements: must run in fresh_context or isolated_subagent
must not reuse generator conclusions as evidence
must record invocationId and reviewed artifact revision
must return block when independent invocation is unavailable

any missing critical element/binding/fallback/exception/safety/stable-exit behavior produces block

must not reuse generator conclusions as evidence
